title: Stage representation for constructed punctured restriction coefficients
statement: For the explicitly constructed punctured compact-open inverse system and restriction coefficients, every cohomology class of the coefficient colimit sheaf is the spectral cohomology image of one stage class. This only concerns cohomology of stage inverse-image sheaves and the coefficient colimit; it does not identify ambient object cohomology or the specified punctured-neighborhood cocone.

source.place: Tags 01E1 and 03F3, lemma-cohomology-of-open; Tag 01F8, functoriality and canonical comparison

proof.text: Apply the existing spectral-limit class-lifting theorem to the explicit geometric inverse limit and actual restriction presentation, with canonical normalized pullback families. The conclusion is stage representation in the coefficient colimit, before either comparison of cohomology or maps.
